name: Hide Product Categories & Products for WooCommerce
author: vgdevsolutions

sections.description:
Hide Product Categories & Products for WooCommerce gives you complete control over what customers see in your store — without deleting any data.

Hide entire categories or individual products instantly using an intuitive category tree and AJAX-powered live search. Perfect for seasonal inventory management, wholesale catalogs, and member-only products.

🔗 Developed by VGDEV Solutions — WooCommerce plugins for the Greek market.

Key Features:

  • ✅ Hide entire product categories with a single checkbox
  • ✅ Hide individual products using fast AJAX live search
  • ✅ Visual “chip” interface — see all hidden products at a glance
  • ✅ Products hidden from shop page, category pages, tag pages, and search results
  • ✅ No data is ever deleted — restore visibility anytime by unchecking
  • ✅ Category tree structure for easy hierarchy navigation
  • ✅ Works seamlessly with all WooCommerce-compatible themes
  • ✅ Lightweight — no impact on front-end performance
  • ✅ HPOS compatible (WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage)

Use Cases:

  • 🗓️ Seasonal products — Hide summer/winter items when out of season
  • 🏭 Wholesale catalogs — Hide retail products from B2B customers (or vice versa)
  • 🚧 Work in progress — Hide products not yet ready to sell
  • 📦 Out of stock — Temporarily hide unavailable items without deleting them
  • 🎯 Regional availability — Hide products not available in certain regions
  • 🎁 Flash sales prep — Prepare product drops by hiding until launch time

How It Works:

  1. Go to WooCommerce → Visibility Control after activation
  2. Check categories in the tree to hide all products in them
  3. Use the live search to find and select individual products to hide
  4. Selected products appear as visual “chips” for easy management
  5. Click Save Settings — changes take effect immediately on your storefront

No coding required. No data lost. Restore any product with one click.

Developed by VGDEV Solutions — free and premium WooCommerce plugins.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Visibility Control to start hiding categories and products.

No additional configuration needed — the plugin works immediately after activation.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce must be installed and active for this plugin to work.

Will hidden products be deleted from my database?

No, absolutely not. The plugin never deletes any product data. It simply filters products from frontend queries. All your product data, images, prices, and settings remain completely intact. Uncheck a product or category at any time to restore its visibility immediately.

Where do hidden products disappear from?

Hidden products are excluded from the shop page, category pages, product tag pages, and WooCommerce search results. Note: if a customer has a direct URL to a hidden product page, they may still be able to access it directly.

Can I hide a single product without hiding its entire category?

Yes. Use the AJAX live search field to find and select individual products. They will appear as visual “chips” and can be removed at any time.

Does this work with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce HPOS.

Does the category tree show subcategories too?

Yes. The category tree is recursive and displays your full category hierarchy with proper indentation, making it easy to hide parent or child categories independently.

Will this slow down my store?

No. The plugin only adds lightweight query filters on the frontend. It has no impact on page load speed for customers.

Is there a premium version with more features?

The plugin is completely free and open source. For custom development or support, visit vgdevsolutions.gr.
